rawFindings.title: Incorrect watch pattern filtering in watchPatterns function
rawFindings.explanation: The watchPatterns function is updated to accept an array of pattern objects instead of strings. It now checks the .watched property to decide whether to watch a pattern. This is a behavior change from previous code that accepted only string patterns, potentially leading to watching unintended paths if pattern objects without .watched = true were present. However, since the code checks !patternObject.watched and returns early, it avoids watching un-watched patterns. The fix is to ensure only patt
rawFindings.suggestion: Correct usage is to always pass full pattern objects and rely on watchPatterns to filter by .watched. No defect; behavior matches intent.

rawFindings.title: createIgnore function ignores only excludes, ignoring watch patterns filtering
rawFindings.explanation: The new createIgnore function only uses the excludes array for ignoring paths, unlike previous implementation that ignored non-matched patterns and excludes. This changes the behavior to watch files that do not match any watched pattern, which is not intended and may cause unnecessary file watching and processing.
rawFindings.suggestion: Modify createIgnore to also check if the path matches any watched pattern, ignoring files not matching any pattern, to optimize watching and correctly ignore files outside watched patterns.
